subject: STABLE 3 shader-coverage-opus (root handoff items 1-3): create_ex (linked/stage_in/depth) + tessellation compile path; 214 post-tess pairs + 10 stage_in kernels compile on host; binding>15 not cheap
body: Sources: air_bridge.rs 6f823d36 (ComputeExtra :83, tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_tessellated :530, compute_options :2991, tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex :3041; render_outputs_for tess branch only under the new export), air_bridge.h c63ee658 (additive TeguAIRLinkedFunction/TeguAIRComputeCreateOptions/tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex), mali_graphics_compiler.c 4b7f6fb2 (tess_eval_spirv_as_vertex :109 + call :146). Private artifacts: cdylib a43bd2ac (gpu/build/shader-coverage-20261027/libs/air-tess, built from 6f823d36), Mali f8 125b3382. Tests: bridge cargo test 34/34; pipeline pack 142/142 + 463/463 entries byte-identical; check_graphics_draw_varyings 81/81 (+baseline), tile_fetch PASS, generic_texture_lowering 58/58, graphics_specialization 66/66; corpus graphics 0 regressions, 1019/1019 previously-compiling pairs byte-identical code; 400 random kernels byte-identical SPIR-V+package with create_ex. Coverage (LEDGER.md): functions ok 8293 -> 8899/10308; UI vertex 92->111/113, UI fragment 144->169/417 (incl. 8 FaceID/BiometricKit tessellation), CA unchanged 3/7 k, 39/39 v, 93/95 f. Attribution: of +297 graphics pairs since f7, 214 tessellation (mine), 83 from texture-opus's working-tree RT formats in air_bridge.rs. TESSELLATION RUNTIME CONTRACT for api-surface (a): use tegu_air_render_pipeline_create_tessellated (same args as create_with_attachments; metadata.tessellation_emulation); its 'vertex' SPIR-V is the evaluation stage; per generated vertex provide attributes: loc0 uint Metal patch index (patchStart / patch index buffer applied), loc1 uint instance index (base included), loc2.. uvec4[ceil(N/4)] control-point element indices (patch*N+k, or control-point index buffer values), loc30 float3 position_in_patch (quad: u,v,0; triangle: barycentrics); the pipeline's vertex buffers bind as usual (control points/patch attributes are pulled by the shader with PerPatchControlPoint/PerPatch layouts from the vertex descriptor); triangles from the CPU tessellator per Metal partition/winding. Not drawn anywhere yet. BINDING>15: AvatarKit needs 23 distinct VS+FS bindings (count, not only index) -> widening TEGU_MALI_GENERIC_MAX_BINDINGS (plan struct stored in cache entries) + TEGU_GENERIC_DRAW_MAX_BINDINGS (generic_job_ui.h, draw_reorder, render_encoder, nord2_metal_render.c/.h binding[16]) = versioned cache+pack rebuild and render-lead transport change: not done. Remaining big blockers: 204 tess pairs need >16 bindings; MPS linked functions need translator specializedName aliasing (+ MPS runtime values).
